label: Solid material burn extent
reason: extrapolation, no evidence: SAFFIRE-II only tested ~22% O2 (21.5-22.1%) at ~1 atm cabin pressure and 20 cm/s flow; habitat O2 34.0% outside 20-24.0%; pressure 8.2 psia (0.56 atm) outside 0.9-1.1 atm. No estimate is given outside the tested atmosphere.
nonmonotonic_note: possible Goldilocks low-flow regime, may be more flammable than both references: u_eff p05 = 8.0 cm/s is below 10 cm/s, where flame spread over thin solids is known to peak or quench (SAFFIRE tested only 20 cm/s). PSI-62 hypothesis: The unsteady flamelet generated manifold (UFGM) approach was believed to be able to accurately reproduce concurrent flame spread in microgravity, including phenomena such as the “Goldilocks” flammability zone, by coupling near-wall thermal, mass transport, and chemical processes with far-field flow dynamics.

transfer.basis: no transfer: habitat atmosphere outside the SAFFIRE-II test atmosphere (lunar/exploration 34% O2 / 8.2 psia is untested)
